## Metadata Codes

Shairport Sync passes metadata around using a two-part identifier: a **type**
and a **code**. The type is either `core` (metadata passed through from the
source, such as iTunes or an iOS device) or `ssnc` (metadata generated by
Shairport SyNC itself).

---

## `ssnc` Codes (Generated by Shairport Sync)

| Code | Explanation |
| :--- | :--- |
| `PICT` | Payload is a picture (JPEG or PNG). |
| `abeg` | Enter Active State. |
| `abrt` | Audio bitrate report. Payload is `"bytes/samples/rate"`; sent on each report and on reset (as `0/0/0`). |
| `acre` | Active-Remote token for source remote control. |
| `aend` | Exit Active State. |
| `arst` | Audio receiver statistics. Payload is `"missing/too_late/retries"`, sent about once per second. |
| `cdid` | Client advertised Device ID. |
| `clip` | IP address of the client (audio sender). |
| `cmac` | Client advertised MAC address. |
| `cmod` | Client advertised model (e.g., `"iPhone14,2"`). |
| `conn` | AirPlay 2: IP of a client requesting access. |
| `copl` | COMMAND Message Plist. The whole binary plist payload of a `POST /command`. |
| `daid` | DACP-ID for source remote control. |
| `dapo` | Port number of the source's remote control. |
| `disc` | AirPlay 2: IP of a disconnected client. |
| `mdst` | A sequence of metadata is about to start. |
| `mden` | A sequence of metadata has ended. |
| `odsc` | Output format description string (e.g. `"44100/S16_LE/2"`), sent once per session. |
| `paus` | Pause (AirPlay 2 only). |
| `pbeg` | Play stream begin. |
| `pcen` | A picture has been sent. |
| `pcst` | A picture is about to be sent. |
| `pdis` | A timestamp discontinuity of a specified number of frames has occurred. |
| `pend` | Play stream end. |
| `pffr` | The first frame of a play session has been received, with its RTP timestamp and local play time. |
| `pfls` | Play stream flush. |
| `phb0` | The RTP timestamp and local time of the first frame of a play session. |
| `phbt` | The RTP timestamp and local time of a frame, sent at the configured progress interval. |
| `prgr` | Progress metadata from AirPlay (RTP timestamps for start, current, and end). |
| `prmp` | A connection is being pre-empted (terminated). Payload is the connection number. |
| `prsm` | Resume. |
| `pvol` | Play volume, as a string `"airplay_volume,volume,lowest_volume,highest_volume"` in dB. |
| `sdsc` | Source format description string (e.g. `"ALAC/44100/S16_LE/2"`), sent when the decoding chain is set up. |
| `snam` | The name of the AirPlay client (the `X-Apple-Client-Name` string). |
| `snua` | The user agent of the AirPlay client. |
| `stal` | Error: reception of a large piece of metadata (e.g., a picture) has stalled. |
| `styp` | Stream type description (e.g. `"Classic"`, `"Realtime"`, `"Buffered"`). |
| `svip` | The IP address used by the player for the play session. |
| `svna` | The service name of the player. |

---

## `core` Codes (Passed Through from Source)
The `core` codes listed here are the ones that are actively parsed or
forwarded by Shairport Sync. Other `core` codes may pass through without
being specifically interpreted, depending on the source and the build
options.

| Code | Explanation |
| :--- | :--- |
| `asal` | Album name. |
| `asar` | Artist name. |
| `ascp` | Composer. |
| `asdk` | Song Data Kind (one-byte number). |
| `asgn` | Genre. |
| `astm` | Song time (track length) in milliseconds. |
| `caps` | Play status (e.g., playing, stopped, paused). |
| `minm` | Title (Track Name). |
| `mper` | Track persistent ID (64-bit number). |

---
